# Pass Through (SingleTSFrame)

## Description
This component just passes data through.

## Inputs
* **input** (SingleTSFrame): The input DataFrame in the format of a SingleTSFrame: The DataFrame must have a column named "timestamp" and at least one further column. The values in the "timestamp" column must have the UTC time zone and are parsed as timestamps in Pandas datetime64 format with nanosecond precision. All columns besides "timestamp" are value dimensions of the single timeseries.

## Outputs
* **output** (SingleTSFrame): The output DataFrame in the format of a SingleTSFrame.

## Details
This component just passes through data. It can be used to map a dynamic workflow input to multiple component inputs. Its input is of type SINGLETSFRAME and can therefore be used to parse dynamic input data provided during execution or to parse a manual input attached to it correctly as a Pandas DataFrame if it meets the criteria of a SingleTSFrame (see the input description above). Otherwise, an exception will be thrown.
